# Overpass

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Query OpenStreetMap data using Overpass API.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/overpass",
  "type": "OverpassOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/overpass').par.query` (an input) and `op('/overpass').out.data` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.query`, `out.data`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

| `bbox` | `BboxField` | `{"southwest":{"lng":-74.05,"lat":40.68},"northeast":{"lng":-73.9,"lat":40.82}}` |
| `pulse` | `NumberField` | `0` |
